Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: After failing to find an explicit capacity on chiefs.com in Step 4, WebSurfer repeated essentially the same site-restricted search in Step 6 instead of adapting strategy or following the Planner’s fallback to consult authoritative secondary sources (e.g., Wikipedia) or opening/reading actual result pages. This repetition without escalation or source broadening stalled progress and prevented obtaining the clear capacity figure for Arrowhead Stadium.
